stories.title: Westbound I-70 closed due to crash in Arapahoe County
stories.summary: The crash happened west of Watkins early Thursday morning.

stories.title: Denver's KOSI 101.1 switching to Christmas music format for 25th year
stories.summary: Get ready to embrace the holiday spirit as Denver's KOSI 101.1 FM starts its annual nonstop Christmas music broadcast on Nov. 21, marking 25 festive years.

stories.title: 9Cares Colorado Shares telethon happening Thursday | Call 303-577-2080
stories.summary: Help us fill the food banks in our community with a donation during the 9Cares Colorado Shares telethon at 303-577-2080.

stories.title: Denver mild and calmer today, ahead of Friday storm and mountain snow
stories.summary: Partly sunny and seasonal, with highs in the 50s today. A new storm is taking aim on Colorado, bringing more wind and mountain snow Friday into Saturday.

stories.title: US Department of Education investigating Thompson School District
stories.summary: The Thompson School District, based in Loveland, was one of five school districts across the country named Nov. 18 in the latest round of investigations.

stories.title: Adams 12 superintendent to retire after leading district for 17 years
stories.summary: Chris Gdowski, a Thornton High School graduate, steps down in June 2027. The school board expects to select a search firm in December.

stories.title: City puts northeast Denver shelter back in its cold-weather plan after promising not to use it again
stories.summary: Denver says the 4040 Quebec shelter is needed to reach its winter capacity. Critics say the city failed to develop a reliable alternative.

stories.title: ‘One last place where everyone is welcome’: Benefit concert aims to save Jamestown Mercantile
stories.summary: Residents rallied to save "The Merc," with concert at Boulder Theater to raise $1.5 million to purchase and preserve the historic building and cafe space inside.

stories.title: ‘Miss Peggy,’ a lifelong CU Buffaloes fan, celebrating 102
stories.summary: Peggy Coppom said she hoped players remember her as a supporter. “I want them to think I was a good fan, had somebody who cheered for them,” she said.

stories.title: Friends, family search for Roxborough man missing since Monday
stories.summary: Tyler Barton was last seen on the morning of Nov. 16, police said, and was reported missing that night.

stories.title: Denver DA charges 2 teens in deadly shooting
stories.summary: The Denver District Attorney's Office said the teens are accused of killing a man who confronted them when they tried to steal his car.

stories.title: Children’s Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus brings guaranteed snow to a warm Colorado day
stories.summary: The Children’s Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus has launched its annual Snow Days attraction, offering families a winter wonderland with machine-made snow.
